panels.title: Cooling · actual fan output and configured response
Fan speed and hottest temperature over time
panels.description: Actual PWM command, not measured RPM. Temperatures use the hottest fresh controller/node reading. This panel always covers the whole cluster. Gaps indicate unavailable fan telemetry.

panels.title: Configured temperature → fan curve
panels.description: Live policy breakpoints from /etc/clusterhat-fan.json. Off-temperature hysteresis, startup spin-up, smoothing and ramp-down affect the actual history on the left.

panels.title: USB · P1–P4 packet errors and link health
P1 · USB link
panels.description: Controller-side ethpi1. Carrier present does not establish IP/SSH health. Absent means the network interface is not detected; a raw USB boot device may still exist. No telemetry means controller/netclass collection is unavailable. USB panels always cover all four ports, independently of the general machine/interface filters.

targets.expr: ((1 + max(node_network_carrier{job="nodes",node="cbridge",device="ethpi1"})) and on() ((max(up{job="nodes",node="cbridge"}) == 1) and on() (max(node_scrape_collector_success{job="nodes",node="cbridge",collector="netclass"}) == 1))) or on() (0 * ((max(up{job="nodes",node="cbridge"}) == 1) and on() (max(node_scrape_collector_success{job="nodes",node="cbridge",collector="netclass"}) == 1)))

panels.title: USB packet error rate · controller side
panels.description: Current error rate from controller ethpi1–ethpi4. TX is controller → Pi; RX is Pi → controller. Driver error counters are not a packet-loss percentage. Missing counters remain gaps, not healthy zeros. USB enumeration errors before a network interface exists are not counted here.

panels.title: USB packet drop rate · controller side
panels.description: Driver-reported dropped packets, separate from errors. RX is received from the Pi; TX is transmitted toward it. Missing interfaces produce no samples.

panels.title: USB errors · cumulative counters
panels.description: Driver counters since interface creation/reset. Rising values indicate new failures; a flat nonzero value is historical. Counters can reset after device re-enumeration or reboot and can exceed successful packet counts.

panels.title: USB errors · range increase (estimate)
panels.description: Estimated error increments within the dashboard time range. Prometheus accounts for observed counter resets and extrapolates between scrapes, so values may be fractional. No samples means unknown, not zero.

panels.title: USB packets · received / transmitted
panels.description: Controller-side packet throughput. Compare traffic with the error panels to identify stalls or an otherwise idle link. This is not an end-to-end reachability probe.

panels.title: USB traffic · received / transmitted
panels.description: Only the four USB interfaces are included; bridge and Ethernet traffic are excluded to avoid double counting.

panels.title: USB carrier transitions · selected time range
panels.description: Observed carrier changes include startup/re-enumeration as well as cable/link changes. Estimates account for counter resets; a missing counter is unavailable.

panels.title: USB link history
panels.description: Interface/carrier status collected on cbridge. Gaps mean controller/netclass telemetry is unavailable. A present carrier is separate from successful packet delivery or SSH.
